title: Furoji
summary: Furoji is a red-skinned Yama-Titan that can control fire through the art of meditation.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Furoji is renowned for achieving what would take an eternity - mastering fire and, in turn, chaos. {{source|TCG:SAS-005|SAS-005}}

Two [[Organization]] [[Suits]] attempted to take on Furoji but could not get close due to his dazzling wall of flames. {{source|TCG:SAS-005|SAS-005}}

full_text:
Furoji is a red-skinned Yama-Titan that can control fire through the art of meditation.

History

Furoji is renowned for achieving what would take an eternity - mastering fire and, in turn, chaos. [SAS-005]

Two Organization Suits attempted to take on Furoji but could not get close due to his dazzling wall of flames. [SAS-005]

Abilities

Some people believe that meditation can unlock fantastic powers. Furoji is proof that just because a person looks calm and relaxed does not equate to being harmless as he is capable of controlling fire through meditation. He can create walls of flames to keep his enemies at bay, all the while remaining calm and collected. [SAS-005]

== History ==
Furoji is renowned for achieving what would take an eternity - mastering fire and, in turn, chaos. {{source|TCG:SAS-005|SAS-005}}

Two [[Organization]] [[Suits]] attempted to take on Furoji but could not get close due to his dazzling wall of flames. {{source|TCG:SAS-005|SAS-005}}
== Abilities ==
Some people believe that meditation can unlock fantastic powers. Furoji is proof that just because a person looks calm and relaxed does not equate to being harmless as he is capable of controlling fire through meditation. He can create walls of flames to keep his enemies at bay, all the while remaining calm and collected. {{source|TCG:SAS-005|SAS-005}}
